name: film_guide
title: How to make films
description: How to make videos with OpenFilm: how to work with the person, what a film is, and the skills that say how each kind of work is done. Call it before starting film work, and again with a skill's name to read that skill whole.

skill.description: name of a skill to read whole, such as film, media or canvas; omit for the guide and the list of skills

name: film_open
title: Create or open a film
description: Create a film (a folder with film.html, inside the open project) or open an existing one, and show it in the editor in the person's browser, where they watch and edit it while you work.

folder.description: the film's folder, made if missing, inside the open project: an absolute path, or one relative to the project's folder

name: film_look
title: Look at a film
description: Check a film and see it: draws a contact sheet of the whole film with its sound and loudness, single frames, or stretches, and reports problems. Returns the report and the pictures. The film's pages are drawn with the network closed; what they were refused is in the report, with how to bring it into the film. Use it after every change before saying it works.

folder.description: the film's folder, inside the open project: an absolute path, or one relative to the project's folder

what.description: what to look at instead of the whole film: a page (.html) or a media file of the project, relative to the film's folder or absolute

at.description: times such as 4.5 (one frame) or stretches such as 3-6 (a sheet of frames); several are drawn on one sheet

count.description: frames in a sheet (12), or across each stretch of several (3)

full.description: watch every frame of the rendered video for flashes, freezes and black

loudness.description: say how far the mix is from this many LUFS

name: film_render
title: Render a film
description: Render a film to video in the background: the whole film goes to <folder>/<folder name>.mp4 beside film.html, a stretch to .film/cache/render/. Returns a job; follow it with film_job. Render only when the person asks for the video.

folder.description: the film's folder, inside the open project: an absolute path, or one relative to the project's folder

range.description: only a stretch, in seconds, such as 3-6

loudness.description: bring the sound to this many LUFS; -14 for online video

workers.description: browsers drawing at once; each takes about 1 GB of memory (chosen by the memory there is)

out.description: another output file inside the project (.mp4, .webm or .mov)

wait_seconds.description: how long to wait for it to finish before answering (25)

name: film_run
title: Run another OpenFilm command
description: Run another OpenFilm command the guide or a skill names, with the words after `openfilm` as args: get (the person's own media, the free library, voice-over, music, sound effects, transcripts, pictures and video), skills, skill, doctor, and edit, canvas and color. Long ones go on in the background as a job; follow it with film_job. Files named must be in the open project.

args.description: the command and its arguments, such as ["get", "music-search", "--prompt", "calm piano"]

folder.description: the film's folder the command works on (needed by get, edit, canvas and color), inside the open project: an absolute path, or one relative to the project's folder

wait_seconds.description: how long to wait for it to finish before answering (25)

name: film_job
title: Follow a job
description: How a background job (a render, a long command, an install) is going: its state, progress, the files it wrote and its last lines of output. Waits up to wait_seconds for it to finish.

wait_seconds.description: how long to wait for it to finish before answering (25)

name: film_cancel
title: Stop a job
description: Stop a background job. A stopped render keeps the frames it finished: the same render started again carries on from there.

name: film_dashboard
description: What the page shows: what is installed, memory, the editor, the films and the jobs.

name: film_setup
description: Install what is missing: OpenFilm, the render browser, or both.

name: film_studio
description: Show a film (made if missing) in the editor in the person's browser.

name: film_thumbnail
description: A small picture of a film.

name: film_localize
description: Download the web fonts and scripts a film's pages name into the film's folder.
